lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns on the lateral flank posterior to the gill slits. The highest intensity spots are located in the mid-section between the pectoral and dorsal fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a distinct grid-like lattice across the primary flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the long axis of the body. Each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow-based low luminance on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 12-15 discrete, high-luminance blobs of varying sizes, distributed irregularly across the lateral surface with a higher concentration towards the posterior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A remora is attached to the ventral-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin. The trailing edge of the upper caudal lobe shows minor irregularities in the silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit displays a significantly higher density of smaller, less-ordered high-luminance points compared to the structured grid of the posterior flank.
